phase_1.title: Phase 1 · KAC SR-25 / M110 Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 7.62×51mm NATO primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 415 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 415 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 508 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 5-groove bore and accelerates to 783 m/s (3450 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Gas Tube Unlock & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, direct gas tube vents propellant pressure into the internal carrier piston to rotate the multi-lug bolt.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 20-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the KAC SR-25 / M110 staged for its 45 RPM (Two-Stage Match Semi-Auto) cadence.

zh.headline: 奈特 SR-25 / M110 SASS 半自动狙击系统：1990 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 尤金·斯通纳晚年于奈特军械公司亲自主导设计的 SR-25 融合了 AR-10 7.62 威力与 AR-15 60% 操控通用性：自由浮置 5R 比赛重管、同轴直抵缓冲托（19 mm 极低膛轴）与快拆套筒消音器，演化为美军制式 M110 SASS 半自动狙击系统。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：KAC SR-25 / M110 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1990 年问世的 奈特 SR-25 / M110 SASS 半自动狙击系统 由美国奈特军械公司（Knight’s Armament Company）主导研制，定位为经典的直接导气半自动狙击系统。SR-25 衍生型 Mk 11 Mod 0 与 M110 SASS 自 2000 年代起全面取代多支部队传统栓动步枪，开启了西方陆军半自动狙击系统新时代。
尤金·斯通纳晚年于奈特军械公司亲自主导设计的 SR-25 融合了 AR-10 7.62 威力与 AR-15 60% 操控通用性：自由浮置 5R 比赛重管、同轴直抵缓冲托（19 mm 极低膛轴）与快拆套筒消音器，演化为美军制式 M110 SASS 半自动狙击系统。 整件装备总长 1,029 mm（挂装消音器 1,181 mm）、空重 4.88 kg，成为同期狙击步枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1990 年，美国奈特军械公司（Knight’s Armament Company）推出了划时代的奈特 SR-25 / M110 SASS 半自动狙击系统。SR-25 衍生型 Mk 11 Mod 0 与 M110 SASS 自 2000 年代起全面取代多支部队传统栓动步枪，开启了西方陆军半自动狙击系统新时代。 它的核心设计聚焦于尤金·斯通纳亲自定型，与 M16/M4 通用逾 60% 人机操控与扳机组件，奠定了其在狙击步枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 奈特 SR-25 / M110 SASS 半自动狙击系统 的机械灵魂在于其「直接导气（斯通纳内活塞）· 7 突笋旋转枪机 + 自由浮置长导轨与快拆消音器」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，导气管将高压火药燃气直引机框内气室，推动多突笋枪机旋转开锁，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用沙色陶瓷涂层航空铝合金与氮化钢精加工而成。自由浮置铝合金护木彻底隔绝两脚架受力，确保 800 m 持续 1 MOA 内精度，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。奈特 SR-25 / M110 SASS 半自动狙击系统 采用直接导气（斯通纳内活塞）· 7 突笋旋转枪机 + 自由浮置长导轨与快拆消音器。在每个击发周期中，导气管将高压火药燃气直引机框内气室，推动多突笋枪机旋转开锁。借助沙色陶瓷涂层航空铝合金与氮化钢工艺与高强度配合，实现了自由浮置铝合金护木彻底隔绝两脚架受力，确保 800 m 持续 1 MOA 内精度。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 7.62×51mm NATO 弹药规格与 508 mm（20 in）比赛级自由浮置重管 · 5R 右旋膛线（1:286 mm），最高工作膛压约 415 MPa，可赋予弹头 783 m/s 的出膛初速与 3,450 J 动能，有效作用距离达 800 米。
内膛技术特点方面，20 in 自由浮置 5R 比赛枪管配双锁定套筒快拆消音器，实现 1 MOA 内快速连发补射。同时，19 mm 直线同轴后坐缓冲区使射手击发后视野不离瞄具，实现毫秒级快速补射，令其在 45 发/分（两段比赛扳机半自动） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 508 毫米身管与 7.62×51mm NATO 口径，奈特 SR-25 / M110 SASS 半自动狙击系统 实现了每秒 783 米的初速与 800 米有效射程。20 in 自由浮置 5R 比赛枪管配双锁定套筒快拆消音器，实现 1 MOA 内快速连发补射，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 20 发容量的20 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 19 mm 膛轴设计，奈特 SR-25 / M110 SASS 半自动狙击系统 将单发后坐冲量控制在 10.4 N·s 水平。套筒式快拆消音器沿枪管向后套合，大幅降低声光特征且零点偏移极小。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-73）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 20 发容量的20 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与出色的整体工效，套筒式快拆消音器沿枪管向后套合，大幅降低声光特征且零点偏移极小。欢迎在 BAY-73 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 奈特 SR-25 / M110 SASS 半自动狙击系统 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the KAC SR-25 / M110
paragraphs: Introduced in 1990 by Knight’s Armament Company (KAC) in United States, the Knight’s Armament SR-25 / M110 SASS emerged as a defining Direct-Impingement Semi-Automatic Sniper System. Adopted as the Navy Mk 11 Mod 0 and Army M110 SASS, the SR-25 architecture ushered in the modern era of suppressed sub-MOA semi-automatic military sniper systems.

Designed by Eugene Stoner at Knight’s Armament in 1990, the SR-25 fused AR-10 7.62×51mm punch with 60% AR-15 ergonomics, a free-floated 5R match barrel, inline 19 mm bore axis, and quick-detach suppressor — evolving into the U.S. Army M110 SASS. Measuring 1,029 mm (1,181 mm Suppressed) at an unloaded weight of 4.88 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Sniper Rifle class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1990, Knight’s Armament Company (KAC) of United States introduced the Knight’s Armament SR-25 / M110 SASS. Adopted as the Navy Mk 11 Mod 0 and Army M110 SASS, the SR-25 architecture ushered in the modern era of suppressed sub-MOA semi-automatic military sniper systems. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Authored by Eugene Stoner with over 60% control and fire-control commonality with M16/M4 rifles — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Knight’s Armament SR-25 / M110 SASS sits its Direct Impingement (Stoner Internal Piston) · 7-Lug Rotating Bolt with Free-Float Rail & QD Suppressor. Throughout every firing cycle, direct gas tube vents propellant pressure into the internal carrier piston to rotate the multi-lug bolt, containing 415 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in Flat Dark Earth Cerakote 7075 aluminum and nitrided steel, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Free-floated URX quad-rail handguard isolates bipod load from the 5R match barrel, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Knight’s Armament SR-25 / M110 SASS relies on Direct Impingement (Stoner Internal Piston) · 7-Lug Rotating Bolt with Free-Float Rail & QD Suppressor. During each cycle, direct gas tube vents propellant pressure into the internal carrier piston to rotate the multi-lug bolt. Machined from Flat Dark Earth Cerakote 7075 aluminum and nitrided steel, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Free-floated URX quad-rail handguard isolates bipod load from the 5R match barrel.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 7.62×51mm NATO with 508 mm (20 in) Free-Float Match Barrel · 5R RH Rifling (1:286 mm), the Knight’s Armament SR-25 / M110 SASS develops 783 m/s muzzle velocity and 3,450 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 800 meters.

Internally, 20-inch free-floated 5R match barrel mates with a gate-latch over-the-barrel suppressor for sub-MOA follow-ups. Combined with its 45 RPM (Two-Stage Match Semi-Auto) tempo, 19 mm inline bore axis lets spotters and shooters track bullet trace through the optic, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 7.62×51mm NATO through its 508 millimeter bore, the Knight’s Armament SR-25 / M110 SASS achieves 783 meters per second and 800 meters of effective reach. 20-inch free-floated 5R match barrel mates with a gate-latch over-the-barrel suppressor for sub-MOA follow-ups.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 20-round 20-round detachable magazine body with a 19 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 10.4 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Over-the-barrel quick-detach suppressor trims overall length while preserving repeatable zero.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-73), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
